source: Maintained SEED P01: four participants, obols, sigils, curse, rites, raven protection, theft, short board and bounded match. No P01 runtime or historical package exists in the checkout/archive.
authorship: New Codex implementation and design under Martin Melcop Neto's portfolio direction. No recovered code or independent human playtest.
accepted_differences: New eight-venue deterministic C# domain, 20 rounds, one human/three agents, terminal presentation and economic comparison. The historical 48 tiles/15 turns/roster/minigames/LAN are candidate plans, not obligations or restored features.
technology: Core/CLI remain C#/.NET 10 0.1.0 with SDK 10.0.401. Native 0.2.0 consumes Core and the unchanged journal through Godot .NET 4.6.3 / Godot.NET.Sdk 4.6.3. Official engine digest verified, actual source/compiled project pack executed. The pack redistributes owned assemblies and source/config only; installed engine supplies its own APIs.
media: No external art, sound, characters from franchises or SDK/runtime binary redistributed. Vaelis/Madra/Nira/Morrak names come from the seed; venues, rules, policies and feedback are new.
quality_boundary: Technical engine execution and implementing-agent rendered/gameplay review; synthetic inputs, not independent human balance/accessibility/commercial approval. Runtime-dependent project pack, not OS export; Linux x86_64 only verified.
native: New vector board/control presentation; venue inspection and actual fork-based previews, separate confirmation, visible paced rival turns, focus-out stop, actionable objective and Gate/deadline results, atomic autosave and replay resume. No new economy rules or historical art/code import.
